q: In general, an electronic communication system is composed of the transmission, reception, and processing of information between two or more locations with the use of electronic _____.
e: In general, an electronic communication system is composed of the transmission, reception, and processing of information between two or more locations with the use of electronic circuits. waves is not circuits, and signals is not circuits either. Between two or more locations with the use of electronic _____. circuits.

q: The basic components of an electronic communication system are the transmitter, communication channel or medium, receiver and _____ (as a source of disturbance).
e: The basic components of an electronic communication system are the transmitter, communication channel or medium, receiver and noise (as a source of disturbance). Put signal or data in the gap and the sentence describes the wrong physics. The receiver rebuilds the sent signal and hands it to the user. Noise is the unwanted disturbance that rides on the wanted signal.

q: The information source is a device that generates information (messages or data) to be transmitted, and the messages generated by source may be voice, audio, music, video, or _____ (text, image, email....).
e: The information source is a device that generates information (messages or data) to be transmitted, and the messages generated by source may be voice, audio, music, video, or noise (text, image, email...). data is not noise, and power is not noise either. Noise is the unwanted disturbance that rides on the wanted signal.

q: The transmitter is the arrangement that processes the message signal into an appropriate form for transmission and subsequent _____.
e: The transmitter is the arrangement that processes the message signal into an appropriate form for transmission and subsequent reception. Put reflection or absorption in the gap and the sentence describes the wrong physics. The transmitter shapes the message for the channel so a receiver can pick it up.

q: Depending upon the type of communication system, a channel may be copper wires, coaxial cable, optical fibre, radio links, _____ channel or combination of any of these.
e: Depending upon the type of communication system, a channel may be copper wires, coaxial cable, optical fibre, radio links, underground channel or combination of any of these. Put satellite or underwater in the gap and the sentence describes the wrong physics. The channel is the medium that carries the processed message from transmitter to receiver.

q: Noise is an unwanted signal that disturbs, interferes and affects the transmitted signal, and the measure of noise is usually expressed in terms of _____ (signal to noise ratio).
e: Noise is an unwanted signal that disturbs, interferes and affects the transmitted signal, and the measure of noise is usually expressed in terms of SNR (signal to noise ratio). AM is not SNR, and FM is not SNR either. Noise is the unwanted disturbance that rides on the wanted signal.

q: Digital signals are more immune to noise than _____ signals.
e: Digital signals are more immune to noise than analog signals. digital is not analog, and optical is not analog either. Noise is the unwanted disturbance that rides on the wanted signal.

q: The receiver accepts the transmitted message from the channel and converts to a form understandable by _____.
e: The receiver accepts the transmitted message from the channel and converts to a form understandable by machines. Put humans or computers in the gap and the sentence describes the wrong physics. The channel is the medium that carries the processed message from transmitter to receiver. The receiver rebuilds the sent signal and hands it to the user.

q: Receivers contain amplifiers, oscillators, mixers, tuned circuits, filters and a _____ (detector).
e: Receivers contain amplifiers, oscillators, mixers, tuned circuits, filters and a demodulator (detector). modulator and transmitter belong to other processes, not this demodulator case. Demodulation peels the audio or data back off the modulated carrier. The receiver rebuilds the sent signal and hands it to the user.

q: In point-to-point mode, communication takes place over a link between a single transmitter and a _____.
e: In point-to-point mode, communication takes place over a link between a single transmitter and a receiver. Put broadcaster or satellite in the gap and the sentence describes the wrong physics. The receiver rebuilds the sent signal and hands it to the user.

q: In the broadcast mode, there are a large number of receivers corresponding to a single _____.
e: In the broadcast mode, there are a large number of receivers corresponding to a single transmitter. receiver is not transmitter, and channel is not transmitter either. The transmitter shapes the message for the channel so a receiver can pick it up.

q: Analog communication uses an analog signal which varies in amplitude, phase, or some other property with _____.
e: Analog communication uses an analog signal which varies in amplitude, phase, or some other property with frequency. Put time or space in the gap and the sentence describes the wrong physics. Analog communication sends a continuously varying wave for voice, image, or video.

q: Transfer of data in digital communication occurs in the form of digital bit stream, i.e. 0 or 1 over a point-to-point (or) point-to-multipoint transmission _____.
e: Transfer of data in digital communication occurs in the form of digital bit stream, i. e. 0 or 1 over a point-to-point (or) point-to-multipoint transmission medium. wire is not medium, and wave is not medium either.

q: With digital communication, data can be broken into packets as discrete messages and transmission errors can be detected and _____.
e: With digital communication, data can be broken into packets as discrete messages and transmission errors can be detected and corrected. Put amplified or ignored in the gap and the sentence describes the wrong physics. As discrete messages and transmission errors can be detected and _____. corrected.

q: In line communication, there is a physical connection between source and destination, and the wires that are most popular are co-axial, parallel wire lines, twisted pair cables and _____.
e: In line communication, there is a physical connection between source and destination, and the wires that are most popular are co-axial, parallel wire lines, twisted pair cables and optical fibre. radio wave is not optical fibre, and microwave is not optical fibre either. Line communication keeps a physical wire or fibre between source and destination. In parallel, the same voltage sits across each branch and the currents add.

q: A transmitter encodes a message onto electromagnetic waves through modulation, which changes properties of the wave to represent the _____.
e: A transmitter encodes a message onto electromagnetic waves through modulation, which changes properties of the wave to represent the data. Put noise or power in the gap and the sentence describes the wrong physics. The transmitter shapes the message for the channel so a receiver can pick it up. Modulation writes the message onto amplitude, frequency, or phase of a carrier.

q: A transducer is a device for converting a non-electrical input into an electrical signal (or) vice versa, and the process of converting energy from one form to another is known as _____.
e: A transducer is a device for converting a non-electrical input into an electrical signal (or) vice versa, and the process of converting energy from one form to another is known as modulation. Put transduction or induction in the gap and the sentence describes the wrong physics. Modulation writes the message onto amplitude, frequency, or phase of a carrier.

q: Transducer contains two parts that are closely related to each other, i.e. the sensing element and _____ element.
e: Transducer contains two parts that are closely related to each other, i. e. the sensing element and transmission element. Put reception or transduction in the gap and the sentence describes the wrong physics.

q: The sensing element is called the sensor, which is a device which produces a measurable response due to a change in physical _____.
e: The sensing element is called the sensor, which is a device which produces a measurable response due to a change in physical conditions. Put states or phases in the gap and the sentence describes the wrong physics. A sensor gives a measurable electrical response when a physical condition changes.

q: The process of changing some characteristics (e.g. amplitude, frequency or phase) of a carrier wave (e.g. radio wave) in accordance with the intensity of the signal is known as _____.
e: The process of changing some characteristics (e. g. amplitude, frequency or phase) of a carrier wave (e. g.

q: In modulation, the sound wave is electrically impressed on an _____ wave.
e: In modulation, the sound wave is electrically impressed on an electromagnetic wave. Put acoustic or mechanical in the gap and the sentence describes the wrong physics. Modulation writes the message onto amplitude, frequency, or phase of a carrier.

q: Modulation permits the transmission to occur at high frequency while it simultaneously allows the carrying of the _____ signal.
e: Modulation permits the transmission to occur at high frequency while it simultaneously allows the carrying of the audio signal. Put video or data in the gap and the sentence describes the wrong physics. Modulation writes the message onto amplitude, frequency, or phase of a carrier.

q: When the amplitude of high frequency carrier wave is changed in accordance with the intensity of the signal, it is called _____ modulation.
e: When the amplitude of high frequency carrier wave is changed in accordance with the intensity of the signal, it is called frequency modulation. Put amplitude or phase in the gap and the sentence describes the wrong physics. Modulation writes the message onto amplitude, frequency, or phase of a carrier.

q: In amplitude modulation, only the amplitude of the carrier wave is changed in accordance with the intensity of the signal but the frequency of the modulated wave (i.e. carrier frequency) remains the _____.
e: In amplitude modulation, only the amplitude of the carrier wave is changed in accordance with the intensity of the signal but the frequency of the modulated wave (i. e. carrier frequency) remains the same. Put different or zero in the gap and the sentence describes the wrong physics.

q: Amplitude modulation is commonly used to transmit information in portable two-way radios, VHF (Very High Frequency), aircraft radios and in computer _____.
e: Amplitude modulation is commonly used to transmit information in portable two-way radios, VHF (Very High Frequency), aircraft radios and in computer modems. Put routers or switches in the gap and the sentence describes the wrong physics. Modulation writes the message onto amplitude, frequency, or phase of a carrier. AM changes carrier amplitude with the signal strength.

q: When the frequency of carrier wave is changed in accordance with the intensity of the signal, it is called frequency modulation (FM), and the amplitude of the modulated wave (i.e. carrier wave amplitude) remains the _____.
e: When the frequency of carrier wave is changed in accordance with the intensity of the signal, it is called frequency modulation (FM), and the amplitude of the modulated wave (i. e. carrier wave amplitude) remains the different. same is not different, and high is not different either.

q: The frequency variations of carrier wave in FM depend upon the instantaneous _____ of the signal.
e: The frequency variations of carrier wave in FM depend upon the instantaneous amplitude of the signal. Put frequency or phase in the gap and the sentence describes the wrong physics. Wave in FM depend upon the instantaneous _____ of the signal. amplitude.

q: Phase modulation is a modulation pattern that encodes information as variations in the instantaneous _____ of a carrier wave.
e: Phase modulation is a modulation pattern that encodes information as variations in the instantaneous phase of a carrier wave. Put amplitude or frequency in the gap and the sentence describes the wrong physics. Phase modulation writes the message as swings in the carrier's instantaneous phase. Modulation writes the message onto amplitude, frequency, or phase of a carrier.

q: Unlike FM, phase modulation is not widely used for transmitting radio waves, but is used for signal and waveform generation in digital _____.
e: Unlike FM, phase modulation is not widely used for transmitting radio waves, but is used for signal and waveform generation in digital amplifiers. synthesizers and receivers belong to other processes, not this amplifiers case. Phase modulation writes the message as swings in the carrier's instantaneous phase. Modulation writes the message onto amplitude, frequency, or phase of a carrier.

q: The process of recovering the audio signal from the modulated wave is known as demodulation or _____.
e: The process of recovering the audio signal from the modulated wave is known as demodulation or detection. Put transmission or emission in the gap and the sentence describes the wrong physics. Demodulation peels the audio or data back off the modulated carrier.
